title: Senior Product Manager - Investments
description:
About the opportunity 
 We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager for our Investments team to take our Wealth products to the next level. Our Investments team is dedicated to empowering retail investors by building accessible, transparent, and innovative investment products. We believe that investing should be intuitive, fair, and aligned with long-term financial success.
 As a leader within our Product team, you’ll drive the evolution of our core investment offerings, ensuring they are best-in-class for retail investors while also being scalable, compliant, and well-integrated with partners and platforms. You'll work cross-functionally with engineering, design, business, data, compliance, and external stakeholders to build investment products that meet the needs of our customer base.
 This role requires deep domain expertise—you should have a strong grasp of investment products from a retail investor’s perspective and an understanding of the ecosystem, partnerships, and infrastructure required to deliver these products at scale. You’ll need to balance customer needs, regulatory requirements, while driving execution and delivering results.
 In this role, you will: 
 Define and execute product strategy and roadmap for the team, aligning with company goals and market opportunities.
 Lead end-to-end product development for investment products, from ideation to launch and iteration.
 Collaborate with stakeholders across the company to build and scale investment solutions.
 Analyze data to continuously refine product offerings and identify new opportunities.
 Drive growth, engagement, and retention of investment products.
 Foster a data-driven, customer-first culture.
 What you need to be successful: 
 Background: 
 5+ years of product management experience, with at least 2+ years focused on investment products or wealth management.
 Experience at a fintech company, brokerage, robo-advisor, asset management firm, or investment platform is strongly preferred.
 Experience working with third-party partners, regulatory bodies, and financial institutions to bring investment products to market.
 Skills: 
 Strategic Thinker : Able to craft a long-term product vision while executing effectively in the short term.
 Execution-Focused : Strong ability to ship products, drive operational excellence, and navigate complex financial ecosystems. Biased for action.
 Analytical & Data-Driven : Strong ability to interpret investment data, market trends, and user insights to inform product decisions.
 Autonomy & Ownership : Thrives in an entrepreneurial, fast-moving environment with a high level of independence and responsibility.
 Strong Stakeholder Management : Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, compliance, legal, marketing, and finance teams.
 Communication & Leadership : Excellent ability to articulate product decisions, drive alignment, and influence at all levels of the organization.
 Regulatory & Risk Acumen : Ability to navigate the complex regulatory landscape of investments while balancing user experience and compliance requirements.
 Bonus points if you have:
 Experience working with embedded finance, direct indexing, crypto, or alternative investments.
 Familiarity with portfolio construction, risk modeling, or tax optimization strategies.
 Experience with investment-related APIs and integrations.
 What’s in it for you: 
 Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀.
 Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation. 
 Come together with your team in the office for a dedicated day of teamwork each week, plus another day of your choice, and enjoy the flexibility of remote work the rest of the time. Some roles may require additional in-office presence .
 As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.    
 Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.  
 A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, life experiences and family statuses. 
 A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.
 Who we are 
 N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.
 We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do. 
 We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Madrid and Barcelona, and a 1,500-strong team of more than 80 nationalities.
 Sounds good? Apply now for this position. 
 Equal Opportunities: 
 We recognize that our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring to our workforce. We strive to build talented and diverse teams to drive our business success and empower our people to reach their full potential.
 We genuinely welcome and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, cultures, genders, sexual orientations, abilities, neurodiversities, and ages. We're committed to creating an inclusive workspace where everyone feels valued and respected, free from harassment and discrimination. If there's anything you need to make the application process work for you, please let us know by reaching out to candidate.exp@n26.com . 
 Visit our website to learn more about Diversity, Equity, & Inclusion at N26.

title: Senior Product Manager - Shipment
description:
ABOUT US
What if your work could drive change in a globally established industry, shaping processes that touch every corner of the world? At Forto, we are at the forefront of change, harnessing the power of AI to revolutionise logistics. We want to reinvent digital supply chains to be transparent, frictionless and sustainable. From day one, our mission has been to simplify global trade – creating a seamless and efficient logistics process.
YOUR ROLE & MISSION 
You'll own the trusted view of every shipment's journey, from origin pickup to final delivery. When something changes, Ops and customers should hear it from us first, and trust what they hear. You'll also drive Forto's top priority, profitability through operational efficiency, by turning manual monitoring into agents that watch, flag and act, so Ops can focus on decisions and customers. Along the way, you'll build the foundation that lets our virtual operator (our AI-assisted operations model) scale from our first lane, China → Germany, to every lane after it.
WHAT YOU WILL DO 
 - Own visibility and monitoring for shipment execution: schedules, partner integrations, our tracking engine, milestones, container and release status, and exception signals.
 - Own our three monitoring agents (origin, main carriage, and destination delivery), from roadmap through adoption.
 - Decide how we turn conflicting signals from carriers, terminals and truckers into one status Ops and customers trust.
 - Work side by side with origin and destination Ops to find where they lose time, then design workflows they actually adopt.
 - Place bets and de-risk them through small experiments and incremental delivery, together with your dedicated EM, Staff Engineer and Designer.
REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
 - 4+ years in product management on software products, ideally complex B2B or operational tooling.
 - A track record of shipping products that changed how people work and moved business metrics.
 - Experience with third-party data you don't control: integrations, event streams or status feeds.
 - Strong influence without authority. The Ops teams you depend on don't report to you; adoption comes from buy-in.
 - Comfortable making decisions with imperfect information and working in short iteration cycles.
PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
 - Experience with agentic or AI-assisted workflows that handle messy, real-world inputs.
 - Background in logistics, supply chain visibility, mobility, or another domain driven by physical-world events.
 - Experience designing exception management or alerting that people trust rather than mute.
Don’t fit all of our criteria? That’s okay! We know that you might be hesitant to apply if you don’t meet all our requirements, but here at Forto, we pride ourselves on embracing diverse perspectives and celebrating potential. If you are passionate about this position and the Forto values, please apply anyway. There could be a place for you in this role - or another one that’s a perfect fit! 
WHY WORK WITH US?
Our team is hard-working, constantly seeking to maximise the impact of their work, but we put our people first, always winning with care. We value efficient systems and swift, direct communication. We want everyone to have their time to speak, so that we can embrace diverse perspectives to help drive towards solutions always.

title: (Mid-Senior) Project Manager - Workday Optimization & HR Transformation (m/f/d)
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.   
 You will join Flix’s People & Organization in the Digital Transformation team to lead our HRIS transformation programme to optimize our processes, revamp payroll ecosystem and define the target operating model for a human-led, AI-partnered and agent-operated People function. 
 As (Senior) Project Manager (m/f/d), you will bring structure to a large, fast-moving transformation across various workstreams. You will turn ambition into a plan, a decision framework and a delivery rhythm that HR, our internal Workday technology team and external partners can all follow. 
 The role reports to the Head of Digital Transformation, and will work closely with People Operations, People Partners, Centres of Expertise and Tech teams. 
 This role is based in Berlin , with a minimum office presence of 3 days per week. 
 About the Role 
 Lead HRIS transformation , owning the integrated plan, milestones, dependencies and RAID log across the HRIS revamp, payroll transition and operating-model workstreams, and keeping all our functional and tech teams working as one delivery engine 
 Set up project governance and decision frameworks , including master data ownership, DACI/RACI and decision rights, intake and prioritization, escalation paths and steering forums 
 Plan and facilitate process revamp workshops with our process owners, People Partners and CoEs, driving as-is/to-be gap analysis, global-first standardization with justified local variants, and clear process ownership across the hire-to-retire lifecycle 
 Translate business needs into technical requirements , working with our HRIS tech team, user stories, acceptance criteria, testing and UAT, release readiness and documentation 
 Steer a complex global payroll transformation including middleware solutions, integrations, parallel runs, sign-offs and cut-over, and building a repeatable migration playbook 
 Manage stakeholders and drive proactive change management  with transparent reporting, risk escalation, adoption metrics and a calm, structured presence when priorities shift
 About You 
 7+ years of experience managing complex, multi-country transformation programmes in HR technology, with a track record of delivering in a global-local environment 
 Proven experience in Workday transformation projects, such as optimization, business process redesign or platform revamps, with enough technical fluency to challenge and align with configuration, security and integration teams. Workday certifications are an advantage 
 Hands-on experience in payroll transformation , such as vendor migrations, country roll-outs, parallel runs and cut-over planning. Experience with global payroll providers is a strong plus 
 Experience shaping target operating models and governance frameworks , including service delivery models, master data governance, DACI/RACI and decision-rights design 
 Strong workshop and process-revamp skills, with the ability to facilitate cross-functional groups, map as-is/to-be processes (e.g. BPMN) and reach decisions without losing momentum 
 Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including influencing senior leaders, translating between business and technical teams, and staying calm and building structure in ambiguity. Familiarity with works council and multi-country compliance requirements is a plus 
 Strong hands-on knowledge of Jira and Confluence . Certifications in project management or agile delivery (e.g. PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Scrum) are a plus.
 We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!   
 What We Offer 
 Travel perks : 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family.  
 Work from (M)Anywhere : Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year.  
 Hybrid work model : We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.  
 Wellbeing support : Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members.  
 Learning & Development : Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills.  
 Mentoring Program : Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.  
 To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link:  Locations - Flix Career 
 Why Join Flix? 
 At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path. 
 As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work. 
 If you’re ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

title: Product Operations Manager (Remote Eligible)
description:
Headquarters: -REMOTE, USA-
 For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.
 We're looking for a Product Operations Manager to help our product org run smoothly, ship faster, and make better decisions. You'll own operational processes across product planning, launch readiness, and team cadences — and you'll be the connective tissue between product, engineering, design, and GTM.
 You will report to our Sr. Manager of Product Operations, and you may work remotely from anywhere in the US where Smartsheet is a registered employer.
 What You'll Do 
 Support and own product planning cycles — quarterly planning, goal tracking, retrospectives, and weekly team rhythms
 Drive launch coordination: maintain checklists, track cross-functional dependencies, and ensure teams are go-live ready
 Build and maintain product health dashboards; surface actionable data to support prioritization decisions
 Document processes, build playbooks, and identify where workflows can be tightened or automated
 Facilitate meetings and ensure follow-ups are captured and closed
 Partner with analytics to answer the right operational questions, not just report on what's already tracked
 What You Bring 
 2–4 years of experience in product operations, program management, or a similar operational role
 Strong process instincts — you see the gaps before they become problems
 Comfort with data: you can pull insights from dashboards and translate them into clear recommendations
 Excellent written communication and meeting facilitation skills
 Experience with tools like Smartsheet, Jira, Confluence, or similar
 A builder mindset — you look for ways to automate before defaulting to manual
 Nice to Have 
 Familiarity with GTM or launch coordination workflows 
 Exposure to AI productivity tools in an operational context
 Current US Perks & Benefits: 
 Employer subsidized medical/vision and dental coverage for full-time employees
 401k Match to help you save for your future (50% of your contribution up to the first 6% of your eligible pay)
 Monthly stipend to support your work and productivity
 Flexible Time Away Program, plus Sick Time Off
 US employees are automatically covered under Smartsheet-sponsored life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability plans
 US employees receive 12 paid holidays per year
 Up to 24 weeks of Parental Leave
 Personal paid Volunteer Day to support our community
 Opportunities for professional growth and development including access to Udemy online courses
 Company Funded Perks, including a counseling membership, local retail discounts, and your own personal Smartsheet account
 Teleworking options from any registered location in the U.S. (role specific)
 Smartsheet provides a competitive base salary range for roles that may be hired in different geographic areas we are licensed to operate our business from. Actual compensation is determined by several factors including, but not limited to, level of professional, educational experience, skills, and specific candidate location. In addition, this role will be eligible for a market competitive incentive opportunity. 
 US Base Salary Pay Range $107,500 — $127,500 USD  
 Get to Know Us: 
 At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.
 Equal Opportunity Employer: 
 Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information. 
 If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.
 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/smartsheet-product-operations-manager-remote-eligible

title: Product Manager, Care Delivery
description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA; Remote, US
 Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Through Maven Enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, and menopause and midlife — improving clinical outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and expanding equitable access to high-quality care at scale. Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP-1 care programs purpose-built for women. Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com
 An award-winning culture working towards an important mission –  Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including:  
 TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026)
 Fortune Change the World (2024)
 CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024)
 Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024)
 Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024)
 Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023)
 Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024)
 About the Role:  
 Care Delivery is the infrastructure that powers how Maven members access care and how our providers deliver it. Every program we run across maternity, fertility, menopause, and pediatrics, depends on it. It's where clinical workflows, provider tooling, and the systems that make care measurable, billable, and scalable at Maven's scale all come together.
 We're looking for a Product Manager to help build that platform: the EHR and clinical tooling, provider workflows, messaging, and the data and billing infrastructure that turn Maven's care model into something reliable and scalable. You'll own defined capabilities within the platform and drive them from problem to shipped, in close partnership with engineering, clinical, design, and operations. It's a high-leverage seat. What you build here touches every program Maven offers.
 You'll report to the Group Product Manager, Care Delivery, and work closely with our providers, as well as Clinical Product, Member Experience, Operations, and the Data and AI Platform teams.
 What You’ll Do: 
 Own specific Care Delivery capabilities end-to-end, provider workflows, clinical documentation, messaging, scheduling and matching, or quality and billing infrastructure, from problem definition through launch and iteration.
 Make crisp, well-reasoned product decisions, especially where clinical accuracy and provider experience are both at stake.
 Use AI hands-on to move faster, prototyping with AI tools to test ideas and pressure-test flows before committing engineering time, and identify and build AI-powered capabilities into the care delivery platform where they genuinely improve the provider or member experience.
 Partner daily with engineering and design to ship reliable platform capabilities, and with clinical and operations partners so that what you build works for real providers and members.
 Translate regulatory and quality requirements, like HEDIS measures and clinical coding, into clean product experiences that add value without adding friction.
 Instrument what you ship, watch how it performs, and iterate. Bring data to every decision.
 Build platform primitives, reusable capabilities that serve many programs, rather than one-off features.
 Bring a point of view on how AI can improve care delivery workflows, and put it to work in how you build.
 What You’ll Bring:  
 3+ years in product management, ideally with some time in healthcare tech or another complex, regulated, or operations-heavy domain.
 A strong executor: you take ambiguous problems, break them down, and ship, without needing everything defined for you.
 Solid data instincts: you define the right metrics, work with real datasets, and communicate findings clearly to both clinical and commercial audiences.
 Comfort with technical and clinical complexity: you can hold your own in an engineering sprint and a clinical review, and you're eager to learn the domain fast (FHIR, interoperability, EHR workflows).
 Genuine care for providers and members: the people using what you build show up in your decisions.
 Clear, direct communication and strong cross-functional collaboration.
 Fluency with AI and a genuine desire to build with it: you understand how modern AI models work well enough to know where they're reliable and where they aren't, you reach for AI tools to prototype and think, and you're excited to ship AI-powered features rather than just talk about them.
 Bonus: experience with EHR or EMR systems, clinical workflows, healthcare interoperability, or provider-facing tools.
 The base salary range for this role is  155,000-185,000 per year. You will also be entitled to receive equity and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on qualifications, experience, and skillset.
 Maven embraces a flexible hybrid work model. This role is open to candidates in remote locations with a strong preference for San Francisco, CA; secondary locations include Seattle, WA and New York, NY. 
 Our teams primarily operate from the New York Metropolitan area, NY, San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, and Seattle, WA. For those in our New York City office, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to work onsite three days a week  (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday). For those based in San Fran

title: Senior Product Manager, User Acquisition
description:
RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile. 
 We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.
 We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance. 
 This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading.
 The Role
 As Senior Product Manager, User Acquisition, you'll explore an important extension of how RevenueCat helps developers grow: helping them not just monetize the users they have, but acquire more of the right users in the first place.
 RevenueCat already has several footholds in user acquisition, including our Apple Ads integration and integrations across the attribution and MMP ecosystem. But we're still early in defining what a broader RevenueCat user acquisition product should become. You'll be the first dedicated product hire focused on this space, reporting directly to our product lead for Ads, with significant latitude to shape both the strategy and the products we build.
 This is a genuine zero-to-one role. You won't inherit a predetermined roadmap. Your job will be to deeply understand how app developers acquire users today, identify where RevenueCat has an opportunity to solve problems meaningfully better, and turn those insights into products we can test, ship, and scale.
 You'll bring real expertise in mobile performance marketing and user acquisition to that process. The opportunity could eventually span attribution and measurement, products built on top of existing acquisition channels, new ways to optimize spend using downstream monetization data, partnerships, advertising infrastructure, or things we haven't considered yet. We have hypotheses, but we're hiring you in part because we want your perspective on which ones are worth pursuing.
 RevenueCat has some unusual advantages to build from: relationships with a large ecosystem of app developers, deep visibility into subscription and monetization outcomes, infrastructure already embedded in apps, and a growing advertising business. The challenge is figuring out how those assets can translate into something uniquely valuable for developers trying to grow.
 About you:
 You have 5+ years of experience owning meaningful product or growth decisions end-to-end. Your title may have been Product Manager, founder, growth leader, or something else — what's important is that you've been accountable for deciding what to build and whether it worked.
 You have deep, hands-on experience with mobile user acquisition—either directly managing and optimizing acquisition for mobile apps, or building products and infrastructure used by mobile acquisition teams. You understand how app developers actually acquire users, measure performance, and make decisions about where to spend their next dollar.
 You understand the modern mobile acquisition stack, including MMPs and attribution, Apple Ads, Meta and Google advertising products, conversion APIs, and related measurement infrastructure.
 You can reason clearly about attribution, performance-marketing economics, and privacy. You understand concepts such as CAC, LTV, ROAS, optimization signals, ATT, SKAdNetwork/AdAttributionKit, consent management, and how downstream behavior should influence acquisition decisions.
 You thrive in zero-to-one environments. You can take a large, ambiguous opportunity, identify the most important unanswered questions, narrow it into product bets, and find pragmatic ways to test those bets before making large investments.
 You are sufficiently technical to work closely with engineering on integrations, APIs, SDKs, data flows, identity, attribution, and other technical product decisions.
 You communicate clearly across different audiences and media, particularly in writing.
 In the first month, you'll:
 Spend significant time with developers understanding how they acquire users today, how they evaluate acquisition performance, and where the process is painful, expensive, fragmented, or opaque.
 Build a deep understanding of RevenueCat's existing acquisition-related products, integrations, data, customer research, and technical capabilities.
 Build strong working relationships with engineering, design, data, go-to-market, and other product teams whose work intersects with user acquisition.
 Develop a clear picture of the acquisition ecosystem, the problems RevenueCat is particularly well positioned to solve, and the biggest assumptions we still need to test.
 Begin forming your own point of view on where RevenueCat could create differentiated value in user acquisition.
 Within the first 3 months, you'll:
 Have narrowed the broad user acquisition opportunity into a small number of concrete product hypotheses, grounded in customer research, market understanding, and RevenueCat's unique advantages.
 Have a clear recommendation for where we should focus first — and why.
 Begin validating that direction through prototypes, design partners, technical exploration, lightweight product experiments, or an initial shippable bet.
 Establish a learning agenda that makes the biggest risks and unanswered questions explicit, and gives us a fast path to increasing or decreasing our conviction.
 Align senior stakeholders around what we're testing, what we're not pursuing yet, and what evidence would cause us to change direction.

title: Senior Product Manager, AI Products & Agentic Hospitality (f/m/d)
description:
About the role 
 At Apaleo , we're building the open, API-first property management platform for hospitality. With integrations across hundreds of apps through the Apaleo Store, and the first AI agent marketplace for hospitality in our Agent Hub, we simplify operations, elevate the guest journey and drive revenue growth for our customers. 
 We're looking for a senior Product Manager to ownin our AI product domain. You'll turn our AI capabilities into coherent, commercially viable products that solve real operational problems for hoteliers. Your goal is to help hotels move towards genuinely autonomous operations, not to ship isolated automations or AI assistants. 
 This is not a backlog role. You'll take an ambiguous opportunity, find the right customer problems, define the proposition, build it with Engineering, bring it to market and drive adoption. You'll also play a central role in turning our AI capabilities into a meaningful and growing source of revenue. 
 This is a senior individual contributor role with real autonomy. You won't receive a roadmap and execute it. You'll shape it along our vision, using customer insight, data and sound reasoning.  What you'll be up to 
 Productising and commercialising our AI capabilities . Define the proposition, target customers and use cases, and shape packaging and launch with commercial teams. 
 Building the foundations for AI across our ecosystem. Shape how our AI capabilities understand each hotel's context and work reliably with Apaleo and connected systems across operational areas. 
 Productising hospitality knowledge. Turn hospitality expertise and operational processes into scalable product experiences, with appropriate human oversight. 
 Driving autonomy and measurable value. Think in complete outcomes, such as staff hours saved and manual work removed. Show hoteliers tangible ROI. 
 Driving adoption. Run discovery, shape onboarding and usability, measure adoption and improve from real-world feedback. 
 Keeping AI products reliable and viable. Define good agent performance, understand cost and latency, set up evaluation and monitoring with Engineering, and trade off autonomy, reliability, human intervention and cost. 
 Owning strategy, roadmap and delivery in your scope , with clear specs, a definition of done and impact analysis. 
 Working with Engineering on trade-offs, dependencies, quality and our API-first AI-first architecture. 
 Balancing ambition with reality. Weigh the roadmap against operational requests, bugs and technical debt, and say no to good ideas that aren't great ones. 
 Spotting dependencies early with Hotel Operations and other engineering teams, since our AI capabilities build on the core platform. 
 Using AI in your own PM work and championing AI-assisted engineering. 
 What you'll bring 
 6+ years as a Product Manager, owning products from discovery through launch and adoption with limited day-to-day direction. 
 Proven zero-to-one experience. You've taken a new B2B product, not a feature, from an ambiguous problem to paying customers, driving discovery, validation, definition, prioritisation and launch. 
 Ownership after launch. You've owned a revenue, adoption or retention number and can tell us what moved and what you killed, pivoted or repriced. 
 Commercial thinking. You've defined propositions, packaging and pricing, validated willingness to pay and worked with Sales, Marketing and Customer Success on go-to-market. 
 Systems and process thinking. You break processes into steps, decisions and handoffs, and understand how systems with different data models and sources of truth affect the reliability of agents. 
 Meaningful AI product experience. You've built and launched AI-powered products or capabilities used by real customers, understand what makes a product agentic, and can discuss context, tools, latency, cost and evaluation, with a view on human-in-the-loop design. 
 Customer centricity and product judgement. You turn interview patterns into opportunities, make tough trade-offs and prioritise ruthlessly. 
 Platform thinking. You weigh customer needs against reusable capabilities, API consistency and long-term platform evolution. 
 Stakeholder alignment. You align Engineering, commercial teams and peers, manage cross-team dependencies and communicate trade-offs with confidence. 
 Autonomy and adaptability. You take ownership, raise risks early and make progress through ambiguity. 
 Strongly preferred 
 Agentic AI products in production. You've taken an agentic AI product beyond prototype to paying customers, and dealt with reliability, permissions, exceptions, human intervention and evaluation. This is different from AI-powered features such as chatbots, summarisation or copilots. 
 Nice to have 
 Hospitality technology or hotel operations experience. 
 Experience with PMS, RMS, CRS, channel managers, OTAs or hospitality distribution. 
 Experience in B2B SaaS platforms, ecosystems or integration-heavy products. 
 Experience with AI governance, permissions, identity, orchestration or enterprise AI adoption. 
 Experience in a fast-moving startup or scale-up. 
 Comfort with AI-assisted engineering processes. 
 Don't tick every box? Hospitality experience is an advantage, not a prerequisite. A strong zero-to-one B2B product builder from another domain, with real AI product experience and a commercial mindset, can be a better fit than a hospitality specialist without them. We'd still love to hear from you. 
 Who you are 
 You take high ownership. You answer for product outcomes, not just delivery commitments. 
 You're strategic and hands-on. You can set a product vision and still get into customer discovery, operational processes and detailed product decisions.

title: AI Venture Builder / Founder in Residence (m/f/d) - Turkey remote
description:
Build & own a business inside GoStudent 
 About GoStudent Builders
 We bring the customers. You build the company.
 With GoStudent Builders, we're turning validated business opportunities into independent, revenue-generating businesses. We provide the infrastructure, customer access, technology and operational support. You build and run the business.
 We currently have 14 validated opportunities across several markets.
 Learn more: 
 The opportunity
 We are looking for AI-native builders who want to build and operate a business from the ground up — not simply manage an existing team or project.
 You can apply as an individual or as a team of 1–3 people. You will take ownership of one specific business opportunity, validate it, launch it and grow it into a profitable company.
 The business challenge for this market
 1. Maturità and medical school entrance prep
 2. YKS and LGS prep beyond Istanbul
 3. Holiday camps at scale
 4. A creator network for performance marketing
5. AI agent for lead follow-up and win-back
 What you'll do
 Take ownership of one of the identified business opportunities.
 Build and launch a revenue-generating business from scratch.
 Use AI tools, automation and GoStudent 's infrastructure to move fast.
 Validate customer demand, develop the offering and acquire customers.
 Own the commercial performance, operations and growth of your business.
 Continuously improve the business based on customer feedback and data.
 What we're are looking for
 You are an entrepreneurial builder who enjoys turning ideas into real businesses.
 You are AI-native and use AI tools to build, automate and execute faster.
 You are hands-on: you build, test, launch and iterate yourself.
 You have strong ownership and are comfortable operating independently.
 You are commercially minded and focused on generating revenue.
 You are fluent in English; some opportunities may require the local language.
 Previous experience in education is not required.
 What GoStudent s provides
 Access to more than 200,000 customers and an established network of 850+ locations.
 Existing infrastructure, licenses, sales capabilities and operational support.
 Access to BrutalOS, GoStudent 's AI agent platform.
 The opportunity to build on an established platform rather than starting entirely from zero.
 The business model
 This is an entrepreneurial ownership opportunity, not a traditional salaried position.
 You own 75% of the business; GoStudent owns 25% .

 GoStudent charges a fee on revenue routed through its channels.

 Location and setup
 Location: Italy & Turkey, remote
 Working model: remote
 Team size: Individual applicants or teams of 1–3

 Start date: January 2027
 How to apply?

 What you've built: In five lines, tell us what you've built and why you're the right person or team for this opportunity.

 Something you've built: Share one project you're proud of, including a link to the product, repository or project.
 Ready to build something of your own? Apply now and turn your ambition into a business you own.

title: Senior Product Manager – Devices (all genders)
description:
tonies is the world’s leading interactive audio platform for children, with over 12 million Tonieboxes and 173 million Tonies sold globally. Our intuitive, screen-free system empowers children to learn and play independently in a safe and engaging way.
With a presence in over 100 countries and a diverse portfolio of ~1,500 Tonies across multiple languages, we continue to redefine how children experience storytelling and learning. Since our IPO in 2021, our global team of 630+ colleagues is united by a shared mission: shaping the future of play, learning, and imagination.
**Senior Product Manager – Devices (all genders)**
**This role may not be a great fit if...**
* **You haven’t yet worked on consumer-facing connected devices.** We need hands-on product management experience taking IoT or smart tech hardware to market, ideally end to end.
* **You prefer to work within clearly separated functions.** 
 This role looks beyond the device itself, to how it lands with customers and kids. Working closely with the other teams within the wider product function, collaboratively developing and delivering brilliant products.
* **You’re looking for established processes and formal tooling.** We’re still building our infrastructure, and you’ll often be the one creating structure rather than stepping into it.
* **You prefer to be handed a roadmap.** We need someone who spots what needs doing, picks it up independently and brings others along.
**Your Role & Impact**
We're looking for an experienced **Senior Product Manager – Devices** to shape and evolve our connected consumer products, creating exceptional experiences that bring together hardware, software and digital services.
This is a senior individual contributor role with significant cross-functional leadership responsibility. You'll lead through influence, aligning multidisciplinary teams, driving decisions and ensuring that product ambitions translate into compelling, technically feasible and commercially successful products.
Working across engineering, design, digital, commercial and global development partners, you'll take a holistic view of the product experience, from the physical device and its connected ecosystem through to the way families interact with it every day.
We're looking for someone who combines **deep connected consumer product experience, strong commercial judgement and the ability to lead complex product development in a matrix organisation.**
**What you'll do**
* **Product vision and strategy:** Own and evolve the product vision, strategy and roadmap for tonies devices, grounded in consumer insight, market opportunity and business objectives.
* **End-to-end product ownership:** Lead product development from early exploration and concept validation through requirements, development, launch and ongoing optimisation.
* **Connected product experiences:** Shape seamless consumer experiences across physical hardware, embedded software, connectivity, mobile applications and digital services.
* **Matrix leadership:** Lead and influence cross-functional teams across hardware, software, engineering, design, operations and commercial functions, driving alignment, accountability and effective decision-making.
* **Product requirements and prioritisation:** Translate consumer needs into clear, actionable product requirements, balancing customer value, technical feasibility, development complexity and commercial impact.
* **Commercial ownership:** Develop compelling business cases and navigate product economics, including pricing, COGS, investment requirements and feature trade-offs.
* **Development partnerships:** Work closely with internal engineering teams and external development and manufacturing partners to deliver against product requirements, quality standards and commercial objectives.
* **Go-to-market collaboration:** Partner with Product Marketing, Brand and Commercial teams to ensure strong product positioning, compelling customer propositions and successful launches.
**What You Bring**
* Significant product management experience in **connected consumer electronics, IoT or software-enabled physical products**, with demonstrable end-to-end product ownership.
* Strong understanding of the interaction between **hardware, firmware, connectivity, mobile applications and cloud-based services** in delivering an integrated consumer experience.
* Proven experience leading multidisciplinary product teams within a **matrix organisation**, influencing senior stakeholders and driving decisions without direct reporting authority.
* Experience developing product strategies, roadmaps and requirements that balance customer needs, technical complexity and commercial objectives.
* Strong commercial acumen, including business case development, pricing, product costs and investment trade-offs.
* Experience working closely with engineering teams and external development or manufacturing partners; ODM experience is advantageous.
* Comfortable navigating ambiguity, challenging assumptions and bringing clarity and structure to complex product decisions.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical complexity into clear product direction and compelling narratives.
* Collaborative, pragmatic and confident working across international teams and cultures.
* Fluent English. German or Mandarin would be advantageous.
**Location:** Candidates must be based in the UK (London), Germany (Düsseldorf or Berlin) or France (Paris).
**Why Join Us?**
* **Global Teamwork**: We collaborate across departmental and country borders. You’ll be part of a truly international community where every voice is heard.
* **Come as you are:** This applies to the dress code and everything else. We believe you give your best when you feel truly comfortable being yourself.
* **Competitive Package**: We offer a competitive salary and a range of comprehensive benefits tailored to your specific location, which we’ll share during the recruiting process.

title: IT Product Manager (m/w/d) Customer & Client Care
description:
Willkommen bei Rhenus!
 Die Rhenus Gruppe ist einer der führenden, weltweit operierenden Logistikdienstleister. Entlang der gesamten Supply Chain bieten wir maßgeschneiderte Lösungen für Unternehmen aus den unterschiedlichsten Branchen. Von multimodalen Transporten bis zur perfekten Lagerung, vom reibungslosen Verzollen bis zu innovativen Mehrwertdiensten: Wir sind immer am Puls der Zeit und an der Seite unserer Kunden.
 Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen: 
 Kontinuierliches Training: Entwickle Deine Fähigkeiten und erweitere Dein Fachwissen mit unseren professionellen Weiterbildungsprogrammen.
 Flache Hierarchien: Dank unserer schlanken Organisationsstruktur kannst Du direkt mit den Entscheidungsträgern in den Austausch gehen.
 Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Wir bieten Ihnen flexible Arbeitszeiten, die zu Ihrem Lebensstil und Ihren persönlichen Anforderungen passen.
 Home Office: Genieß die Freiheit, von zu Hause aus zu arbeiten.
 Unbefristete Arbeitsverträge: Komm' um zu bleiben! Wir bieten Dir die Sicherheit, die Du brauchst, um entspannt durchzustarten und Deine Zukunft zu planen.
 Raum für Innovation: Setze Deine Ideen in einem Umfeld um, das Kreativität fördert und Dich befähigt, Veränderungen voranzutreiben.
 Das erwartet Dich bei uns: 
 Du entwickelst in cross-funktionalen Teams IT-Produkte für den internationalen Einsatz und verantwortest die Maximierung des Business Value Deiner Produkte.
 Ausgehend von der Produktvision leitest Du die Produkt-Roadmap ab, priorisierst das Product Backlog und definierst User Stories sowie Akzeptanzkriterien.
 Du analysierst und optimierst die Customer Journey entlang relevanter Touchpoints und leitest daraus Maßnahmen zur Verbesserung der Customer Experience sowie digitale Service- und Self-Service-Lösungen ab.
 Du verantwortest die fachliche Weiterentwicklung von CRM-, Ticketing- und Contact-Center-Lösungen, deren Integration in bestehende Logistiksysteme sowie den Einsatz innovativer Technologien wie Automatisierung und Conversational AI.
 Du nutzt Customer-Experience-Kennzahlen zur Priorisierung und Weiterentwicklung Deiner Produkte und arbeitest eng mit internen Entwicklerteams, externen Partnern und relevanten Stakeholdern zusammen.
 Das bringst Du mit: 
 Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes technisches oder betriebswirtschaftliches Studium und bringst mindestens drei Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung als Product Owner oder Product Manager mit.
 Du begeisterst Dich für Logistik und verfügst über ein fundiertes Verständnis von Customer-Care- und Serviceprozessen, idealerweise im Logistik-, E-Commerce- oder B2B2C-Umfeld.
 Du bringst Erfahrung mit Customer-Experience-Methoden wie Customer Journey Mapping, Design Thinking oder Service Design sowie Kenntnisse in CRM-, Ticketing- oder Contact-Center-Lösungen mit.
 Du bist methodisch versiert, mit agilen sowie plangetriebenen Ansätzen des Projektmanagements vertraut und hast Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklerteams und externen Implementierungspartnern.
 Du verfügst über gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift und überzeugst durch Deine Kundenorientierung, Kommunikationsstärke, Eigeninitiative sowie eine selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise.

title: Product Owner:in – Basic Infrastructue (all genders) – 2 Jahre befristet
description:
Über uns
Wir wollen etwas bewegen – bist Du dabei? Wir sorgen dafür, dass über 80 Millionen Menschen in Deutschland von einer digitalen Gesundheitsversorgung profitieren können. Einige Produkte von uns, wie das E-Rezept oder die elektronische Patientenakte (ePA), kennst Du vielleicht schon. Gestalte mit uns das Gesundheitssystem von morgen.
Im Bereich Solution Management verbinden wir tiefgreifendes Know-how zur Telematikinfrastruktur mit breiter technologischer Kompetenz und ausgezeichneten Projektmanagementfähigkeiten. Wir verantworten Planung und Durchführung komplexer Umsetzungsvorhaben und sind Ansprech- und Lösungspartner:in für Digitalisierungslösungen mit der Telematikinfrastruktur. In diese Projekte bringen wir uns von der Analyse bis zur Implementierung und Integration mit Energie und Leidenschaft ein. Du arbeitest in einem dynamischen Team von erfahrenen Expert:innen und unterstützt uns bei übergreifenden Architektur- und Entwicklungsaufgaben. Hilf uns auf dem Weg in die Arena für digitale Medizin.
Als wesentlicher Teil des Agile Release Train (ART) Basic Infrastructure verantwortest Du die Produktqualität und Termintreue als Teamleistung eines crossfunktionalen Teams im Rahmen des Produktentwicklungsprozesses. Dabei planst Du die Entwicklungsperioden und sicherst Support und Services rund um ausgewählte Produkte der Telematikinfrastruktur (TI).
Deine Aufgaben
 Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung verschiedener Bausteine der Telematikinfrastruktur und überführst sie in die TI 2.0. Für Dein Team ownst Du das Backlog.
 In enger Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Stakeholder:innen priorisierst Du Anforderungen und steuerst die Umsetzung durch Dein agiles Team mittels der Erstellung von User-Stories.
 Du arbeitest mit Scrum, Kanban oder anderen agilen Methoden, um die Produktentwicklung effizient und flexibel voranzutreiben.
 Du bist verantwortlich für die effektive und effiziente Steuerung beauftragter Dienstleister:innen und gehst sorgsam mit dem Dir übertragenen Budget um.
 Du übernimmst die fachliche Führung eines heterogenen und interdisziplinären Teams und bist bereit, auch in Dich als Person des Leaderships zu investieren.
 Du hältst Dich über Trends und Innovationen im Bereich Infrastruktur-Komponenten auf dem Laufenden, um strategische Entscheidungen fundiert zu treffen.
 Dein Profil
 Abschluss: Du hast Dein Studium erfolgreich abgeschlossen oder kannst eine vergleichbare Qualifikation nachweisen.
 Erfahrung: Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner, idealerweise im Bereich Infrastruktur-Produkte (bspw. Verschlüsselungstechniken, digitale Identitäten, Secure Communications, Signaturdiensten), bevorzugt im Gesundheitswesen.
 Tool- & Methodenkenntnisse: Du bist ein:eleidenschaftliche:rVerfechter:in agiler Arbeitsweisen und hast umfassende Erfahrung mit Scrum, Kanban oder ähnlichen Frameworks.
 Arbeitsweise: Du durchdringst technische und geschäftliche Anforderungen schnell und entwickelst sie strategisch weiter. Mit Deiner Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung interdisziplinärer Teams gehst Du souverän mit unterschiedlichen Charakteren um und kannst klar aufzeigen, wie sich Deine Lernreise als fachliche Führungsperson bisher entwickelt hat.
 Persönlichkeit: Du zeichnest Dich durch hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten aus und verstehst es, komplexe technische Sachverhalte verständlich zu vermitteln. Auch Gremien aus Stakeholder:innen und dem gematik-Management kannst Du souverän bespielen.
 Sprache: Du hast sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
 Du erfüllst nicht alle Anforderungen? Kein Problem, bewirb Dich trotzdem! Wir prüfen jede Bewerbung individuell und freuen uns darauf, Deine einzigartigen Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen kennenzulernen.
Das bieten wir Dir
 Job mit Sinn: Wir verpassen dem Gesundheitssystem ein Update – Denk mit uns Gesundheit digital. 
 Perspektive & Entwicklung: Die Position ist auf zwei Jahre befristet mit Option auf Verlängerung. Wir bieten Dir nicht nur einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz, sondern auch vielfältige Chancen zur persönlichen und beruflichen Weiterentwicklung – durch individuelle Weiterbildungen, das „Mitarbeitende schulen Mitarbeitende“-Programm, Workshops, Messen und Konferenzen. 
 Agiles Arbeitsumfeld: Bei uns liegt der Fokus auf abteilungsübergreifendem Austausch und der Zusammenarbeit in crossfunktionalen Teams. Dabei stehen gemeinsames Lernen und die Freude an der Arbeit im Vordergrund. 
 Benefits: Neben einem attraktiven Gehalt bieten wir Dir 30 Tage Urlaub sowie zusätzlich freie Tage am 24.12. und 31.12., Gesundheits- und Sportangebote, Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket, Mitarbeitendenevents, Corporate Benefits und vieles mehr. 
 Mobiles Arbeiten: Innerhalb Deutschlands ist mobiles Arbeiten möglich, sowie eine bis zu 30-tägige Workation im europäischen Ausland (EU, EWR, Schweiz). 
 Work-Life-Balance: Vereinbarkeit von Privatleben und Beruf ist uns wichtig, daher gestaltest Du Deine Arbeitszeit flexibel. Wir sind flexibel und gehen auf Deine individuellen Bedürfnisse ein, einschließlich des Wiedereinstiegs nach der Elternzeit – gerne auch in Teilzeit, wenn es für Dich passt. 
 Wir freuen uns auf Dich!  
Vielfalt macht uns stark! Deshalb haben alle Menschen bei uns die gleichen Chancen. Ganz egal ob weiblich, männlich, divers, mit Behinderung und unabhängig von Alter, ethnischer oder religiöser Zugehörigkeit oder ob Du nach einer Elternzeit wieder einsteigst. Dein Beitrag verbessert die Gesundheitsversorgung von morgen! Wir sind überzeugt: Ein respektvolles, wertschätzendes und offenes Miteinander ist die Grundlage, um das Gesundheitssystem erfolgreich zu digitalisieren.

title: Commercial Product Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Mobilität neu denken
 Fahrgastinformation mit Mehrwert
 WIR WACHSEN: AM MARKT. IM TEAM. AN UNSEREN AUFGABEN. WACHSE MIT!
 Bei Televic Rail haben wir eine klare Mission: Wir entwickeln und liefern innovative, zuverlässige Fahrgast-informations- und Kommunikationssysteme für den weltweiten Rail-Markt. Seit über 40 Jahren gestalten, produzieren, programmieren und warten wir mit Leidenschaft vollintegrierte Hard- und Softwaresysteme für den Schienenverkehr.
Unsere Technologie ist heute in mehr als 60.000 Fahrzeugen weltweit im Einsatz und jeden Tag kommen neue hinzu. Innovation, Agilität, Kundenorientierung und Nachhaltigkeit sind die treibenden Kräfte hinter allem, was wir tun.
Werde Teil von Televic Rail und gestalte die Fahrgastinformation der Zukunft aktiv mit. Deine Begeisterung und Dein Know-how sind der Schlüssel, um unsere Kunden zu begeistern und den Rail-Bereich noch smarter zu machen.
 Commercial Product Manager (m/w/d)
 Hybrid | Berlin, Berlin, Deutschland | 60.000 € - 90.000 € pro Jahr |Engineering
 Deine Aufgaben
 Produktstrategie & Roadmap
 Entwicklung und Steuerung der Produktstrategien und Roadmaps für TFT-Anzeigen, Audiosysteme sowie die zugehörigen Hardware-, Software- und Systemplattformen
 Identifikation von Marktpotenzialen und Erstellung wirtschaftlich fundierter Business Cases
 Kommerzielles Produktmanagement
 Verantwortung für Produktpositionierung, Preisstrategien und Profitabilität unseres Portfolios
 Steuerung des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus sowie Unterstützung strategischer Make-or-Buy-Entscheidungen
 Kunden & Business Development
 Beratung internationaler Kunden sowie Durch-führung von Workshops und Produktpräsen-tationen
 Unterstützung von Sales und Bid Management bei strategischen Projekten und Ausschreibungen
 Markt & Wettbewerb
 Analyse von Markttrends, Kundenanforderungen und Wettbewerbsentwicklungen
 Identifikation neuer Geschäftspotenziale in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Product Marketing
 Team & Zusammenarbeit
 Fachliche Weiterentwicklung anderer Product Manager und Mitgestaltung unserer Product-Management-Strukturen
 Förderung der bereichsübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit zwischen technischen und kommerziellen Teams
 Deine Kompetenzen
 Erfahrung & Expertise 
 Abgeschlossenes Masterstudium, idealerweise in Ingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Betriebswirtschaft oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung
 Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement technischer Hard- und Softwareprodukte
 Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Lieferanten im asiatischen Markt ist von Vorteil
 Fundierte Kenntnisse in Produktstrategie, Road-maps, Pricing und B2B-Kundenmanagement
 Kommerzielles Know-how
 Unternehmerisches Denken sowie Erfahrung mit Business Cases, Profitabilitätsanalysen und Port-foliomanagement
 Technischer Background
 Technisches Studium oder vergleichbare Berufserfahrung
 Verständnis von Embedded Systems, Netz-werk-technologien, Cybersecurity und Produk-tlebens-zyklen
 Sprachen
 Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englisch-kenntnisse, jeweils mindestens auf C1-Niveau
 Persönliche Stärken
 Ausgeprägte Umsetzungsstärke, gepaart mit Pragmatismus und einem Gespür für den effi-zienten Einsatz von Ressourcen
 Strategisches Denken, Kommunikationsstärke und Freude an bereichsübergreifender Zusam-menarbeit
 Eigeninitiative, Überzeugungskraft und Bereit-schaft zu internationalen Dienstreisen
 Unser Angebot
 Bei uns geht es nicht nur um Produkte, Roadmaps oder Pricing, sondern darum, Marktpotenziale zu erkennen, Kunden-bedürfnisse zu verstehen und daraus wirtschaftlich erfolgreiche Produktstrategien zu entwickeln.
Im Commercial Product Management gestaltest Du unser Portfolio aktiv mit und verbindest dabei Technologie, Markt und Business. Gemeinsam mit internationalen Teams entwickelst Du unsere Produkte strategisch weiter und sorgst dafür, dass aus technischen Lösungen langfristig erfolgreiche Produkte werden.
Für diese Position ist ein Jahresbruttogehalt zwischen 60.000 und 90.000 € vorgesehen. Die finale Einordnung richtet sich nach Deiner Qualifikation, relevanten Erfahrung und fachlichen Tiefe.
 Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen:
 Gestaltung & Entwicklung: Viel Eigenverantwortung bei Produktstrategie, Roadmaps und Portfolioentscheidungen sowie Raum für persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklung.
 Flexibilität & Benefits: 30 Tage Urlaub, 13. Gehalt, flexible Arbeitszeiten, Remote Work sowie Zuschüsse für Jobticket, Jobrad oder einen betriebseigenen Parkplatz.
 International & relevant: Zusammenarbeit mit Teams, Kunden und Partnern weltweit an technologisch anspruchsvollen Lösungen für den internationalen Schienenverkehr.
 Kultur & Zusammenarbeit: Offene Kommunikation, kurze Entscheidungswege, viel Vertrauen und ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Eigeninitiative ausdrücklich gewünscht ist.
 Bei Televic glauben wir daran, dass jeder Einzelne dazu beiträgt, unsere Vision zu verwirklichen. Wenn Du bereit bist, diese Herausforderung anzunehmen und Dein Potenzial zu entfalten, dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung!
Werde jetzt Teil unseres Teams, wir können es kaum erwarten, von Dir zu hören!
 Noch Fragen? Ich bin für Dich da.
 Du erreichst mich jederzeit per WhatsApp.
Kristin Werner +49 174 743 1662

title: Chief of Staff (m/f/d)
description:
About Us
 MRI is the best tool for early detection of cancer and targeted interventions, but conventional scanners are costly, require cumbersome infrastructure and are impractical for procedures.
DeepSpin has developed Magnetic Resonance Guidance (MRG): a compact, open MR system that brings MR imaging into the procedure room and, over time, into screening at the point of care and to the billions of people who currently don’t have access to it.
 About Position
 As Chief of Staff at DeepSpin, you will work directly with the CEO on strategic initiatives, ranging from investor relations and fundraising over clinical partnerships to product strategy and roadmap.
Your Responsibilities
 Investor relations & Fundraising: Work directly with the founders on strategic planning, investor relations, fundraising materials, and board meeting preparation.
 Grant Funding: Identify, write, and manage public grant applications to secure non-dilutive funding for R&D and clinical initiatives.
 Project Management & Development Planning: Develop and refine our product development plan, including timelines, deliverables, and resource allocation
 Product Strategy & Use Case Expansion: Define our product roadmap and identify new clinical use cases, working closely with clinical partners and our tech team to align technical feasibility with customer needs.
 Clinical Partnerships & Evidence: Build and manage relationships with clinical partners, overseeing collaborative validation studies and driving joint scientific publications.
 Requirements
 Education: Successfully completed studies in medicine, life sciences, or biomedical/related engineering - a clinical/medical background is preferred.
 Relevant Experience: 3+ years of experience in management consulting, high-growth startups, or product/project leadership, ideally within the medical technology or healthcare sector.
 Technical & Clinical Acumen: High customer empathy paired with a strong technical understanding of/or deep interest in MRI and AI technologies.
 Language Proficiency: Full professional proficiency in German and English (written and spoken), including strong formal writing skills required for drafting public grant proposals, regulatory correspondence, and executive communications in German. 
 Grant & Stakeholder Fluency: Demonstrated ability to communicate complex scientific and business concepts clearly across clinical, technical, and investor audiences.
 Execution Mindset: A highly motivated self-starter with strong project management, organizational, and analytical skills as well as high agency
 What We Offer
 International environment: A diverse and multicultural English-first office with more than 10 different nationalities driven by the same purpose, to revolutionize medical imaging
 Competitive Compensation: A total compensation package value of up to 130.000 € per year consisting of 75.000 - 90.000 € salary and stock options
 Benefits: Urban Sports Club, BVG and lifestyle vouchers along with company-sponsored lunch in our penthouse office and monthly team events
 Personal development: In addition to learning on the job through mentorship and high responsibility from the start, we encourage and support personal development (trainings, certifications etc.).
 Work-life balance: 30 days of paid leave per year and Parental leaves
 Relocation: Support with visa and relocation as well as with finding daycare for your children 
 Dynamic & Innovative Culture: A creative workplace with flat hierarchies and open communication among a highly skilled collaborative team

title: Project manager (f/m/d) driving product development with a focus on software
description:
Do you thrive at the intersection of technology, business and collaboration? Do you enjoy turning complex ideas into clear plans and successful outcomes? And would you like your work to contribute to meaningful healthcare software solutions used globally? Then you might be a great match be our new project manager in Demant Diagnostics.
 Drive innovation across diagnostics 
 You will join a global development environment where collaboration across functions, locations and disciplines is key to success. Reporting to the Senior Manager, NPD Projects, Strategy & Project Portfolio Management, you will work closely with Product Management, R&D, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Operations and Commercial teams across Diagnostics.
 The position can be based at our headquarters in Smørum, Copenhagen, at MAICO in Berlin or at Interacoustics in Middelfart, with flexibility to work from home when tasks allow.
 Make an impact from concept to launch 
 In this role, you will provide the structure, coordination and business perspective needed to bring development projects successfully from concept to release. You will balance technical, regulatory and commercial considerations while leading teams in navigating complexity and delivering results.
 Your key responsibilities include:
 Lead cross-functional product development projects with focus on software from scoping through implementation and release
 Drive change control processes for software updates
 Drive planning, prioritization and execution across multiple functions and stakeholders
 Translate customer, market and business needs into clear project scopes, priorities and deliverables
 Create transparency around milestones, dependencies, risks and decisions
 Facilitate collaboration between Product Management, R&D, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Operations and Commercial teams
 Manage project risks, changes and resource dependencies to support successful delivery
 Present project updates, recommendations and key decisions to leadership and stakeholders
 What You Bring To The Team 
 We are looking for an experienced project manager who combines strong delivery capabilities with sound business judgement. You know how to create alignment across specialist teams and are comfortable operating in environments where software, technology, regulations and commercial objectives intersect. Most importantly, you are a trusted partner who enables teams to perform at their best through structure, collaboration and clear direction.
 We imagine that you have:
 A relevant technical or commercial master’s degree e.g., in Computer Science, Software Development, Business Administration or Project Management
 5-8 years of experience with leading cross-functional product development or software development projects in a medical technology, diagnostics or another regulated industry
 Solid stakeholder management and communication skills across technical and business functions
 Experience leading teams through complex projects involving multiple dependencies and competing priorities
 Solid understanding of software development lifecycles, release management and change control processes
 Ability to balance customer needs, business priorities and technical feasibility
 Familiarity with projects involving both software and advanced electronic hardware products is highly valued
 Work where technology meets business value 
 You will join an international organization where innovation, collaboration and continuous improvement drive our success. The role offers broad exposure across the value chain and the opportunity to work closely with senior stakeholders, technical specialists and commercial leaders. 
 It is an opportunity to further develop your project management expertise while contributing to solutions that make a meaningful difference for healthcare professionals and patients around the world.
 What To Expect From The Recruitment Process 
 We are looking forward to receiving your CV and cover letter no later than Monday the 14th of December. Please note we only accept applications via our recruitment system in accordance with the GDPR legislation. We aim to conclude the recruitment process in December.
 The recruitment process typically includes:
 Application and CV review
 First interview
 Second interview
 Final assessment and offer stage
 At Demant, we value diversity, equity and inclusion and are committed to creating an inclusive working environment where everyone can contribute and succeed. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, nationality, religion, sexual orientation or educational background. We believe diverse perspectives strengthen our teams, products and decision-making. Women in STEM disciplines are particularly encouraged to apply as part of our support for United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 5 on gender equality. 
 About Demant Diagnostics 
 Demant’s diagnostics business is a trusted diagnostic solutions provider in the field of hearing and balance assessment. This group of international companies develops, manufactures, and markets a wide variety of technological solutions globally, delivering instruments, software, training, and services that support the entire diagnostic journey – from early screening to advanced clinical assessment and balance treatment. Our portfolio includes well-known brands such as MAICO Interacoustics, Amplivox, GSI Grason-Stadler, MedRx, Audioscan, and Inventis.
 Our products are sold in more than 100 countries through an extensive network of sales companies and distributors.

title: Project Manager – Product Development | MedTech (m/f/d)
description:
Turn new medical technologies from idea into reality.
